card.name: Linking words before risk and event terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "for" or "of" right after "risk" or "risks" in warnings. Also fires partway through words like Arterial, polysorbate and COVID-19.

modes.label: Words after risk
modes.description: The word "for" or "of" right after "risk" or "risks", before the outcome.
modes.example: ESAs increased the risks<< for>> death and serious adverse cardiovascular reactions.

modes.label: Partway through terms
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a medical term or name, such as Arterial or polysorbate.

modes.label: Dollar sign before number
modes.description: A dollar sign directly before an amount in news text.
modes.example: The president’s push for<< $>>9 an hour has the GOP on the

card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where a risk or a medical term is about to continue.
